name: snaprender
description: Screenshot any website, extract content, and render HTML/Markdown to images. Supports device emulation, dark mode, ad blocking, batch processing, and signed URLs.

api_key.title: SnapRender API Key
api_key.description: Your API key from app.snap-render.com/dashboard (starts with sk_live_). Sign up free at snap-render.com.

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of a website URL, HTML, or Markdown as PNG, JPEG, WebP, or PDF

tools.name: extract_content
tools.description: Extract content from a web page as markdown, text, HTML, article data, links, or metadata

tools.name: check_screenshot_cache
tools.description: Check if a screenshot is cached without using quota

tools.name: sign_screenshot_url
tools.description: Generate a signed URL for a screenshot that works without an API key

tools.name: batch_screenshots
tools.description: Create a batch screenshot job for 1-50 URLs processed in parallel

tools.name: get_batch_status
tools.description: Check the status and download URLs for a batch screenshot job

tools.name: manage_webhooks
tools.description: Create, list, delete, or test webhook subscriptions for event notifications

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Get current month's screenshot usage and remaining quota
